name: Umeme Limited
source: CRON 20261019: H1 2026 column completed from the unaudited interim financial statements for the six months ended 30 June 2026 filed on the Uganda Securities Exchange (extract of the interim condensed statement of profit or loss, UGX million). Printed: revenue from contracts with customers 4, cost of sales nil, gross profit 4, repair and maintenance (16), administration (16,149), foreign exchange gains 3,278, operating loss (12,883), finance income 5,645, finance costs (14,632), loss before tax (21,870), income tax nil, loss for the period (21,870), basic and diluted loss per share (13.5) UGX. Operating Expenses is entered as 12,887, the repair and administration lines of 16,165 less the 3,278 foreign exchange gain, because the panel has no other income row and that is the convention already used for the earlier years of this file; gross profit less that figure reproduces the printed operating loss exactly. Net Finance Costs is 8,987, finance costs 14,632 less finance income 5,645, which reproduces the printed loss before tax exactly. Figures are in shillings, not thousands. Source: https://www.use.or.ug/uploads/faa44c90-65f9-4938-b98b-c714987006ec.pdf

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit, and the column ties with it positive

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT), and the column ties with it positive

rows.label: Net Finance Costs
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored with a negative sign, which broke the printed identity Operating Profit (EBIT) - Net Finance Costs = Profit Before Tax; the magnitude is unchanged and the column now carries the positive cost sign the identity requires

rows.label: ROE (%)
rows.derivedCellFormula: ROE (%) = Net Profit / Total Equity x 100

derivation.ratiosNote: ratio cells tagged derived are arithmetic on the filed figures of this security, not printed in the source

source_note: Absolute UGX (Ushs million x1,000,000). Umeme reports in Ugandan shillings.
